role_and_message.evidence: The figure still depicts the full persistent-coordinator, parallel-worker, shared-workspace/event-queue and Lean-verification coordination loop.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All four worker classes, shared versioned task workspace, root G and H1/H2/H3-prime/H4/H1.1/H1.2 nodes, event queue, coordinator and final Lean/verified-proof path remain.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Dispatch flows coordinator to workers; obligations flow workspace to workers; reports flow down to event queue and return to coordinator; revisions return to workspace. The final route still passes through Lean before verified proof.

visual_encodings.evidence: Blue open/prover, green retained/closed, orange restated and gray retracted encodings preserve original distinctions, with legends explicitly showing status symbols.

examples_and_data.evidence: The example proof tree and report cards are schematic cases, not measured results. Their node relationships and statuses are preserved; no scientific data or proof outcome is fabricated.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Added dispatch/open-obligations/event-report labels and final-proof-route label restate numbered actions in the original Figure 1 caption. No new worker capability or bypass of Lean is introduced.

remaining_limitations: Fidelity is to the supplied figure and source description, not validation of the method. Schematic symbols and decorative portraits may change while labels and relations are preserved.
caption:
Figure 1: MAESTRO’s coordination loop. The persistent coordinator 1 dispatches or redirects
workers, which 2 attack open obligations in parallel and 3 report proofs, diagnoses, progress, or
blueprints to a shared queue. The coordinator 4 consumes these events as they arrive and 5 revises
the shared Lean workspace, here retracting H2 and H1.2, restating H3 as H3’, adding H4, and
keeping the proved H1.1. When the root closes, 6 Lean checks the final proof or falsification.
